banned.claim: Repairs, heals or treats skin conditions like acne, eczema or rosacea
banned.why: Cosmetic claim crossing into drug territory - not permitted for a soap/bath brand under cosmetic rules.

banned.claim: Anti-aging that reverses or turns back aging
banned.why: Structure/function drug claim - use appearance language like 'skin looks smoother' instead.
Structure/function claim - implies altering the body, making it an unapproved drug claim.
No study is present on the site; 'clinically proven' requires substantiation.

banned.claim: Therapeutic aromatherapy benefits such as 'reduces anxiety' or 'cures headaches'
banned.why: Health/structure-function claim beyond permitted cosmetic scent and appearance language.
